Hi Sam —

Thanks again for taking the time to walk through AcmeAI's use case this morning. Quick recap:
- Goal: integrate Redwood inference for customer-facing summarization and routed QA for enterprise accounts.
- Success metrics: 200ms median latency for web traffic, <0.5% error rate on hallucinated facts, cost target ~$0.004 per 1k tokens.

Next step: technical deep dive + demo with Rafael (solutions engineer) to review architecture, sample prompts, and integration patterns. Rafael will cover quantization/backfill strategies and deployment options (hosted vs dedicated).

Proposed 60-minute slots next week (all times PST):
- Tue, Feb 16 — 11:00am or 3:30pm
- Wed, Feb 17 — 10:00am or 2:00pm

If those don't work, feel free to pick a time on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/30min — I recommend selecting a 60m slot.

I attached a short product overview and a proposed deep-dive agenda for Rafael to review beforehand. If you can confirm one of the slots, I'll send a calendar invite and a brief pre-read.

Thanks,
